title: Tarawera Ultra-Trail by UTMB — Spectators
claims: Athletes may receive support crew assistance only at the designated aid stations, and only for the TMiler, T102 and T50; T21 and T14 athletes may not have support crew support, only spectators.

Spectator locations listed are Village Green (finish and event hub), Te Puia (TMiler, T50 and T14 start), Firmin Field Kawerau (T102 start, about a 60-minute drive from central Rotorua), Lake Tikitapu (T21 start and aid station), Puarenga, Buried Village, Rerewhakaaitu, Okataina (shuttle bus only) and Redwoods and Rifle Range.
Any aid station not listed on the page is not accessible to spectators.

Supporters may join the last stretch from the Redwoods aid station after registering with event staff and receiving a wristband, and only supporters of the TMiler and T102 may enter the finish chute with their athlete.
Tarawera Road is closed from 9:45am until about 11am for the T21 race start.
